name: hyperparameter_tuning
selection: For each language/model maximize mean CLEAN validation macro-F1 over two conditions and three seeds (6 scores). Exact ties prefer original parameter. Test never used.
checkpoint_policy: One best weights-only checkpoint per active fit; NO optimizer checkpoints. Interrupted fits restart from scratch. All completed job records survive.
search_cleanup: Delete new weights only after validation predictions reloaded, verified, hashed and record committed.
final_cleanup: For changed parameters retrain, export all 13 test sets, reload and verify predictions, record hashes, then delete new weights. Original selections reuse old predictions.
old_results: Read-only; reuse original 72 validation records and selected old predictions.
